title: Transformation of Synechococcus sp PCC7002
author: Anne Vogel
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.kg2ctye

steps.title: Prepare Starter Culture
steps.instruction: Establish a starter culture of Synechococcus sp PCC7002 in AA+ medium.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate AA+ medium from a -80°C stock, plate, or liquid culture.
Incubate at 33°C with bubbling and approximately 150uE light.
Continue incubation until OD 730 is above 1.

steps.title: Prepare Fresh Culture
steps.instruction: Set up a fresh culture in cleaned and sterile bubbling flasks.

substeps.instruction: Inoculate 150mL AA+ medium with the starter culture to achieve an OD 730 of 0.07.
Incubate at 33°C with bubbling until OD 730 reaches 0.4 (approximately 18 hours).

steps.title: Harvest Cells
steps.instruction: Collect and concentrate the cells from the bubbling flasks.

substeps.instruction: Transfer cells into two sterile 50mL tubes.
Centrifuge at 2500g (~4700rpm) for 8 minutes at room temperature (22°C).
Carefully discard the AA+ medium.

steps.title: Resuspend and Add DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the cell pellet and introduce the linear DNA.

substeps.instruction: Resuspend cells in AA+ medium to a final OD 730 of 8.
Distribute 100uL of the resuspended cells into sterile 15mL test tubes.
Add ~1μg of linear DNA with 50-500nt homologous regions (e.g., purified PCR product).

steps.title: Incubate Cells and Prepare Filters
steps.instruction: Incubate the DNA-cell mixture and prepare the plating surface.

substeps.instruction: Place tubes in a rack in a 30°C cabinet with low light (ca. 30uE) for six hours.
Using sterile tweezers, place sterile filters (Nucleopore SN 145318) on non-selective AA+ plates.

steps.title: Plate and Dry Cells
steps.instruction: Transfer the cells onto the filters and allow them to dry.

substeps.instruction: Plate the whole volume of cells onto the sterile filters on the AA+ plates.
Spread the cells carefully.
Leave the plates to dry in the flow cabinet for approximately 30 minutes.

steps.title: Initial Recovery Growth
steps.instruction: Grow the cells overnight in the 30°C cabinet with low light (ca. 30uE).

steps.title: Selection and Growth
steps.instruction: Transfer cells to selective media for growth.

substeps.instruction: Transfer the filters with the cells onto AA+ plates containing the appropriate antibiotics.
Grow cells in the 30°C cabinet with low light (ca. 30uE) for 2 days.

steps.title: Accelerate Colony Appearance
steps.instruction: Move plates to a higher temperature and light environment to encourage colony growth.

substeps.instruction: Transfer plates to a 33°C incubator with higher light (ca. 150uE).
Place plates near the door to avoid excessive light exposure.
Seal plates well with parafilm to prevent drying.

steps.title: Isolate and Verify Colonies
steps.instruction: Pick and streak colonies to confirm transformation and segregation.

substeps.instruction: Wait for green colonies to appear (potentially against a yellowish background of dead cells).
Pick single colonies with a sterile pipettip and streak them onto selective AA+ plates.
Incubate plates in the 33°C cabinet as previously described.
Wait for colonies to appear and repeat the procedure if necessary.
Perform colony PCR to ensure complete segregation occurred.
